title: Add a standing EndingObeysSkip mutant for L-002 to tests/window/WindowMutants.ps1
how_to_read: Each attempt is one line and a `details` filename in this same directory. Open a detail file ONLY when this index points you at one -- the summaries are here so you do not have to. `caused_by` is what sent the stage back; `changed` is what the attempt then touched, counted by kind. Several attempts in a row that were caused by the same stage and changed no `src` is a loop, not progress.

open.issue: observed: WindowMutants.ps1's -Mutant ValidateSet has no 'EndingObeysSkip' value (has: All, StopDisabled, StopCollapsed, NoCrashHandler, NoExitRule, CancelThrows, HookFailsAfterActing, HookCompileError, HookLocked). No standing mutant proves the guard that keeps a stale, non-final TopLevel row off the screen…
-Mutant's ValidateSet in tests/window/WindowMutants.ps1 offers an 'EndingObeysSkip' value: missing
$CaseMutants has an 'EndingObeysSkip' entry wired to case L-002, mutating src/FsAnalyser.App/MainWindow.xaml.cs: missing
The mutant's Find pattern matches exactly once inside the real, current ShowFinalTopLevel method, and its Replace makes that method consult _skipNextRefresh: missing
The mutant's Fail patterns document the topLevel.final mismatch observed in the manual run: missing

The -Mutant All roster in WindowMutants.ps1 is still a hard-coded list next to the ValidateSet. C-006 guards it for this slice, but deriving it from the ValidateSet (minus 'All') would stop a future mutant from being reachable by name yet missing from All.
The bug report was only a title. The build assumed its intent from the repro test and the design: a standing mutant in WindowMutants.ps1, not a change to the app.
eng/dotnet.ps1 installed SDK 10.0.401 into this worktree's gitignored .dotnet/ (per Q-003), because the machine has only 8.0/9.0. Each worktree installs its own copy (~300 MB).
